about: UI patterns with usage guidance. 'section' is the engine section type that renders it (see docs/GDL.md → ui.screens).

patterns.overwhelmsWhen: It shows every KPI and every table.
patterns.minimum: Goal sentence, needs-you queue, ≤4 headline numbers, next moment of truth, 1–3 primary actions.
patterns.interaction: Every needs item links to the action that resolves it.

patterns.useWhen: Any game with decisions pending (offers, deadlines, crises).
patterns.overwhelmsWhen: > 7 items: group by priority and collapse routine.
patterns.minimum: Priority, one-line what, deadline, resolve button.
patterns.interaction: Inline resolve where possible; otherwise deep link.

patterns.useWhen: Entities with identity (aircraft, shows, restaurants, players, startups).
patterns.minimum: Name, glyph/visual, 2–4 key stats, status chip.
patterns.interaction: Click opens inspector; hover shows quick actions.

patterns.useWhen: Comparing many homogeneous items (all routes, all players, standings).
patterns.minimum: Name + 3–6 sortable columns + row action.
patterns.narrow: Hide low-priority columns; horizontal scroll inside the table only.

patterns.useWhen: Geographic or network structure (routes, locations, supply chains).
patterns.minimum: Nodes sized by importance, links colored by performance, legend.
patterns.narrow: Map scales to width; list below.
patterns.interaction: Click node/link → inspector; filter by owner.

patterns.minimum: Columns = stages, cards = projects with progress and risk chip.
patterns.interaction: Click card → inspector with gate actions.

patterns.overwhelmsWhen: Every field dumped: show key stats, drivers, history chart, actions.
patterns.minimum: Header identity, status, key stats, Why? drivers, actions, history.
Revenue, costs by category, profit, cash trend, debt.

patterns.overwhelmsWhen: Full league table on home: show top 5 + you.
patterns.minimum: Rank, name, metric, delta, highlight player.
Priority, headline, date, entity links.
Value, trend arrow, threshold markers, Why? drivers.
Goal, progress bar, deadline, reward/penalty.
Year markers, milestones, major transactions.
One clear series, labeled axes, current value.
Phase + 'what it means for you' + key prices with sparklines.
Inputs with defaults, preview of cost/impact/risk, what you give up.
patterns.interaction: Live preview as inputs change; keyboard submit.

patterns.overwhelmsWhen: More than one per few minutes of play.
patterns.minimum: Big headline, 1–2 lines, key number, continue/decide.
Search entities and actions.
What changed and why, in one line with numbers.
Side-by-side key stats with better/worse marks.

navigationRules: ≤ 7 top-level destinations, named after player tasks, not data tables.
Depth via tabs inside a destination (≤ 5 tabs).
Every entity reachable via command palette.
Home is always one keypress away (H).
Space advances time; Shift+Space advances to next event.

visualMotifs.departure-board: Split-flap inspired headers: mono uppercase on dark band with amber/white characters; status chips like 'ON TIME/DELAYED'.
visualMotifs.playbill: Cream paper, yellow masthead strip, condensed serif headlines, marquee bulbs for moments.
visualMotifs.broadcast: Score-bug chips, slanted header bars, bold condensed sans, team-color stripes.
visualMotifs.editorial: Newspaper: serif headlines, column rules, small caps datelines, light paper background.
visualMotifs.blueprint: Grid background, technical labels, thin cyan lines, monospace numerics.
visualMotifs.ledger: Green-bar paper, mono numerals, ruled lines, embossed totals.
visualMotifs.menu-card: Warm cream, small caps serif, dotted leaders between item and price.
visualMotifs.terminal: Dark terminal, phosphor accents, mono everywhere, data-dense but crisp.
visualMotifs.deal-room: Off-white memo paper, navy ink, tabbed dossiers, stamped status marks.
visualMotifs.atelier: High-contrast black/white editorial with one couture accent, Didone display type.
visualMotifs.resort: Airy light theme, rounded cards, coastal palette, illustrated map.
visualMotifs.paddock: Carbon dark with livery accent stripes, timing-screen numerics.
